data.body:
**[P2] Set the telemetry polling budget explicitly**

This constructor inherits core's 120-second polling timeout, and `fetch_records` supplies no `completion_check`. Even an immediately available valid record therefore takes approximately 130 seconds with the default pre-wait, instead of the documented ten-second polling window after that wait. `--telemetry-wait-seconds` only changes the pre-wait. Pass an explicit timeout matching the telemetry contract; if retaining the longer budget, provide a completion predicate that respects the retriever's settling period. Add a fake-clock test using the real retriever, since the current mocked tests conceal this delay.
